title: 单粒子逐个穿过双缝形成干涉条纹
posterTitle: 一颗粒子会和「自己」发生干涉吗？
posterHook: 先看波的叠加，再逐个发射粒子累积条纹；打开「观测路径」，亲手让干涉当场消失。
question: 为什么单个粒子也会形成干涉条纹？

en.title: Single particles build an interference pattern at a double slit
en.posterHook: First watch the superposition of waves, then launch particles one by one to accumulate stripes; open the "observation path" and make the interference disappear on the spot.
en.question: Why do single particles also form interference fringes?

title: 旋转圆叠加出方波与周期曲线
posterTitle: 傅里叶级数把周期信号分解为正弦波
posterHook: 增减谐波项数，看圆链末端如何一步步描出方波；还可以随手画一条线，让它现场分解。
question: 一串旋转的圆，为什么能画出任何曲线？

en.title: Rotating circles combine into square waves and periodic curves
en.posterTitle: Fourier series decompose periodic signals into sine waves
en.posterHook: Increase or decrease the number of harmonic terms to see how the end of the circular chain draws a square wave step by step; you can also draw a line and have it decomposed on the spot.
en.question: Why can a series of rotating circles draw any curves?
